exposure: Intratracheal LPS in combination with 50% O2 hyperoxia
outcome: Lung histology (alveolarization, lung injury score, design-based stereology)
cohort: Preterm rabbit pups delivered on the 28th day of gestation were studied, with age-matched rabbit pups delivered vaginally at term used as controls.
finding: Preterm birth itself, without other BPD hits, was associated with lung function deficits, delayed lung development, and cardiovascular abnormalities, with enhanced BPD-like phenotypes achieved through continued exposure to 70% O2 and intratracheal LPS.
gest_age: 28th day of gestation (preterm pups); Term (control pups)
